chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdillāh ibn Marwān al-Anbārī, who said:

I was present at the passing of Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī (عليه السلام). Then Abū al-Ḥasan (عليه السلام) came, and a chair was placed for him, so he sat upon it, and around him were the members of his household, while Abū Muḥammad was standing in a corner. Then when he had finished with the matter of Abū Jaʿfar, he turned toward Abū Muḥammad (عليه السلام) and said: “O my son, renew gratitude to Allah, Blessed and Exalted, for He has brought about in you a matter.”

key_terms.أَمْرًا: a significant matter or affair brought about by Allah
key_terms.يَا بُنَيَّ: an affectionate address meaning: O my son

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith indicate the designation of Abū Muḥammad al-Ḥasan al-ʿAskarī (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This report narrates a moment at the passing of Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī (عليه السلام), when Abū al-Ḥasan (عليه السلام) publicly addressed Abū Muḥammad (عليه السلام). His instruction to give shukr to Allah indicates the occurrence of a significant divinely ordained matter concerning him, understood in this chapter as a designation connected to the Imamate.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abdullah Bin Marwan Al Anbary who said,

‘I was present during the passing away of Abu Ja’far Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup> (9<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>). So Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> (10<sup>th</sup> Imam) came over, and a chair was placed for him<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> sat upon it, and around him<sup>asws</sup> were his<sup>asws</sup> family members, and Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) was standing in a corner. So when he<sup>asws</sup> was free from the matter of Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, he<sup>asws</sup> turned towards Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> and he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O my<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup>! Renew thanks to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High for the command has come to be in you<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 5. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Abdallah ibn Marwan al-Anbari who has said the following.

“I was present at the time of abu Ja‘far Muhammad ibn Ali’s (leaving this world). Abu al-Hassan (a.s.) came and a chair was set for him. He sat on it and his family around him. Abu Muhammad was standing on one side. When he was free from the matters about abu Ja‘far he then turned to abu Muhammad (a.s.) and said, “My son, renew thanks to Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, because He has just granted you a task (Leadership with Divine Authority).”
